documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md; c410, coordinated with RECOVERY-RETENTION.md). Responder: on-call API responder. Keep the reviewed daily 09:00 UTC scheduler cadence. Sum successful chirp-purge completed executions over 24h45m and alert when the sum is below one for five minutes; treat missing data as violating. The combined 24h50m evaluation window is below the API's 25-hour ceiling. Native job counters do not continually zero-fill: archived successes had one trailing zero then no points, so missing-data ACTIVE is essential. The 45-minute grace and five-minute retest are initial operating choices, not measured evaluator latency. Before enabling or modifying this policy, verify a recent successful measurement in the selected series and its actual query result; a never-written or uninitialized series is not proven covered. Disabled, channel-free API acceptance and historical query arithmetic do not prove future incident evaluation or responder delivery. A manual or scheduled success can clear overdue status; it does not independently prove Scheduler health. See the runbook for activation and evidence requirements.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-purge" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result="succeeded"
